changelog: Aura AI v2.4.6 — Phone Automation & App Control Overhaul (Fixes 15–21)
Instagram Reels: Bottom nav Reels tab grounding and 200ms upward flick with reel advancement verification
Instagram DM Target Validation: Excluded bottom nav tabs from contact search; hard abort guard against injecting chat messages into search bars
Enhanced Scroll & Continuous Auto-Scroll: Re-calibrated scroll distances (35%, 65%, 80%) and background continuous auto-scrolling with smart auto-stop triggers
Messaging Chat Row Click: Filtered out avatar/profile picture nodes and biased coordinate clicks to text area with auto-recovery from profile dialogs
Native Phone Dialer: Direct dial_number intent pre-fills native dialpad across all OEM dialers without using search bars
Dedicated App Close & Recents Reopen Guard: Separated close_current_app from clear_all_recents with 150ms upward fling and auto-recovery if an app reopens
Native YouTube Priority: Direct native intent launches com.google.android.youtube by default, reserving In-Built Browser for explicit requests
